zh.title: Ascendance 展出全尺寸 ATEA 混合電力垂直起降航空器原型
zh.summary: 法國 Ascendance 於土魯斯附近展出 ATEA，首飛仍須等候主管機關許可。
body: 法國新創公司 Ascendance 於11月19日在土魯斯附近的米雷－萊爾姆飛行場公開展示全尺寸 ATEA 原型機。這款航空器採混合電力設計，規劃具備垂直起降能力，目前仍在準備飛行測試。
據 AeroTime 報導，Ascendance 已於今年2月公佈示範機機體完工，後續由團隊整合推進、航電及飛控系統。公司先前已選定 Safran 的 ENGINeUS 電動馬達供飛行原型機使用。
AeroTime 引述公司方面指出，原型機首飛有望於2027年初進行，前提是取得主管機關許可。公司尚未公佈首飛的確切日期。

en.title: Ascendance unveils full-scale ATEA hybrid-electric VTOL aircraft prototype
en.summary: The French developer presented the ATEA near Toulouse and is awaiting approval for its flight-test campaign.
body: French developer Ascendance unveiled its full-scale ATEA prototype on November 19 at Muret-Lherm airfield near Toulouse, AeroTime reported. The hybrid-electric aircraft is designed for vertical takeoff and landing, and the company is preparing for flight testing.

Ascendance announced completion of the demonstrator airframe in February, paving the way for propulsion, avionics and flight-control integration. It previously selected Safran’s ENGINeUS electric motor for the flying prototype.
AeroTime reported that Ascendance expects a first flight in early 2027, subject to approval from the aviation authority. The company has not announced a specific date.

facts.claim: Ascendance unveiled the full-scale ATEA prototype at Muret-Lherm on November 19.
The company announced completion of the demonstrator airframe in February 2026.
The initial flight is expected in early 2027 subject to regulatory approval.
